hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; [ "${f##*.}" = "py" ] || exit 0; if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format -q "$f"; elif [ -x venv/Scripts/ruff.exe ]; then venv/Scripts/ruff.exe format -q "$f"; elif [ -x venv/bin/ruff ]; then venv/bin/ruff format -q "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
